analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction about not being notified of a savings rate cut and alleges financial loss of about £43.20 (CH-1).
analysis.summary: The customer says the interest rate on their Harbourline Easy Saver fell from 3.1% to 1.6% in July and they received no letter or email about it. They say they would have moved their money and estimate lost interest of about £43.20, which they want back. A handler note says the rate change notice email bounced and no letter fallback was sent (batch 06/2026). No vulnerability indicators were noted. This is a first contact. Deadline is 2026-12-03, on track.

timeline.event: Easy Saver rate dropped from 3.1% to 1.6%; customer says no notice received.
Handler noted notice batch 06/2026 email bounced and no letter fallback was sent; first contact; no vulnerability indicators; preference email.

analysis.severity_reason: Estimated financial loss of £43.20 is under £100 and there is no other CH-6 High or Medium trigger. First contact only. The bounced notice may affect other customers in the same batch, which is unconfirmed.

vulnerability.suggested_support: None identified. Offer email contact as preferred, but confirm a valid email address because the one on file bounced.

analysis.routing_reason: No ESC-1 trigger is evident: no fraud, lending issue, vulnerability referral, legal or media threat, or technical failure. The handler can resolve it. The handler may wish to consider whether other customers in batch 06/2026 were also affected, as a possible systemic issue for Senior Complaints Review, but the case file does not confirm this.

policy_citations.how_it_applies: Estimated loss of £43.20 is under £100, so severity is Low.
